projectName: Hvilken Båt Er Det I Dag
projectDescription: A React app that displays daily cruise ship schedules for Eidfjord, Norway
keyFeatures: Interactive date navigation with keyboard shortcuts
Detailed ship information including tonnage, passengers, and ports
Anchor status indicator for docked ships
publicApiSurface: DailyMessage - Dynamic message based on ship count
ShipList - List of ships for selected date
ShipListItem - Individual ship card with details
schedule - Jotai atom with React Query for ship data
selectedDay - Jotai atom for current selected date
selectedShipList - Derived atom filtering ships by date
dailyMessage - Derived atom generating contextual message
Ship - TypeScript type for ship data model
